notes: Skyway and flyover run at two separate heights so the systems can cross without a bespoke piece.
Carriageway is 20 m, matching the ground kit and every gate in the building and superstructure kits.
Every socket declares mf_edge_z and mf_carries, so a placer cannot join a skyway to a flyover or a city plate to the low side of an edge.

runtimeIntegration.note: Nothing registered in boot.js or manifest.json.
